Hi Emma (and procurement team),

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — great conversation. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and to make it easy for procurement to route: 

What we covered
- Scope: 6-week pilot for real-time invoice routing + 250k tokens/month usage (inference + embeddings).
- Success metrics: 90% accuracy on OCR-derived line-item mapping, <150ms p95 latency for single-invoice lookups, and measurable reduction in manual triage.
- Security/ops: VPC private deployment available; Redwood provides SOC2 evidence + audit logs.

Agreed next steps
1) I shared an initial SOW and a pricing worksheet (attached). Please confirm the PO/contract owner and any internal deadlines.
2) We offered a prep call with procurement/legal to walk SOW, data flow, and SLAs — available Mon/Wed next week.
3) If budget is locked, we can provision a reserved pilot slot for CityLedger starting the first week of December.

Attachments (attached to this email): CityLedger_Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood_pricing_q4.xlsx

Quick ask: are you still targeting an end-of-quarter decision window for the pilot? If timelines shifted, no problem — just want to align our capacity and the pilot start slot.

Happy to hop on a quick procurement call if that speeds approvals.

Thanks,
